# Heartland Acquisitions

> Heartland Acquisitions is a Kansas City cash home-buying company. We buy houses as-is in any condition across the Kansas City metro on both the Missouri and Kansas sides of the state line. No fees, no commissions, no repairs, no showings. Cash offers within 1 hour of walkthrough. Closing in as little as 7 days.

We are a family-owned business operated by Ivarix Capital LLC (DBA Heartland Acquisitions). We are the actual buyer, not a wholesaler — we purchase properties with our own funds, then renovate and either rent or resell them.

## Service area

Kansas City metro on both sides of the state line: Jackson, Clay, Cass, and Platte counties (Missouri); Wyandotte and Johnson counties (Kansas). Cities include Kansas City MO, Independence, Lee's Summit, Blue Springs, Raytown, Grandview, Belton, Liberty, Gladstone, Kansas City KS, Overland Park, Olathe, Shawnee, and Lenexa.

## Situations we handle (vertical landing pages)

- [Foreclosure](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/situations/foreclosure): We buy Kansas City houses in pre-foreclosure and can close before the trustee sale date. Stops the foreclosure on the seller's credit and pays off the mortgage at closing.
- [Inherited property](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/situations/inherited): We buy inherited homes in Kansas City and coordinate directly with probate attorneys. Out-of-state heirs handled remotely. Sell as-is — leave anything you don't want.
- [Divorce sale](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/situations/divorce): Private cash sale of the marital home — no MLS, no for-sale sign, signatures coordinated separately if spouses aren't speaking. Proceeds split per settlement at closing.
- [Fire-damaged house](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/situations/fire-damage): We buy fire-damaged homes including total losses. Sellers keep insurance proceeds; we pay separately for the property.
- [Rental with tenants in place](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/situations/rental-with-tenants): We buy tenanted rental properties without requiring eviction. Honor existing leases or work with seller on transition. Tired-landlord exits.

In-depth, KC-specific writing for sellers researching their options. Authored by Chase Uhlig, founder.

- [How Cash Offers Are Calculated for Kansas City Houses (No Black Box)](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/how-cash-offers-are-calculated-for-kansas-city-houses): The actual formula cash buyers use to price KC houses — ARV, renovation budget, holding costs, margin. Real example with numbers from a Raytown 64133 sale.
- [How to Sell a House Fast in Kansas City: A Realistic Timeline](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/how-to-sell-a-house-fast-in-kansas-city): What "sell fast" actually means in KC — 7-14 day cash buyer path vs 30-45 day iBuyer path vs 60-90 day MLS listing. Trade-offs between speed, price, and certainty.
- [Selling a Hoarder House in Kansas City: What to Expect](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/selling-a-hoarder-house-in-kansas-city): Practical guide to selling hoarder houses without judgment — walkthrough, "leave everything" mechanics, biohazard considerations, multi-heir dynamics, timeline.
- [Cash Buyer vs Realtor in Kansas City: The Actual Math](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/cash-buyer-vs-realtor-kansas-city-math): Real numbers comparing a cash sale to a traditional listing on a typical Independence MO house. Walks through agent fees, repairs, concessions, holding costs, and net-to-seller for both paths.
- [Selling a House With Title Issues in Jackson County, MO](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/selling-a-house-with-title-issues-jackson-county): Common title issues on KC houses — mechanic's liens, IRS liens, divorce-era clouds, missing heirs, undischarged mortgages — and how each gets resolved at closing.
- [Selling an Inherited House in Missouri: The Probate Timeline (Plain English)](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/selling-inherited-house-missouri-probate-timeline): Practical guide to MO probate for heirs — 6-12 month timeline, when to sell during probate, Medicaid recovery liens, multi-heir splits, revocable trust skip-probate path.
- [What Closing Day Looks Like at a Kansas City Title Company](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/what-closing-day-looks-like-kansas-city-title-company): Walkthrough of closing day — what to bring, the documents you'll sign, common questions, when the wire actually hits, what can delay things.
- [Behind on Mortgage Payments in Kansas City: Your Options Before Foreclosure](https://heartlandacquisitions.com/blog/behind-on-mortgage-kansas-city-foreclosure-options): Options ranked by impact — reinstatement, loan modification, forbearance, short sale, cash sale before trustee auction. Plus what to avoid (foreclosure-rescue scams) and free HUD-counselor resources.

## What we buy

Single-family homes, duplexes, and small multi-family properties. Vacant, occupied, tenanted, condemned, fire-damaged, hoarder, or distressed houses — we make fair offers on all conditions.

## How offers are calculated

We look at comparable properties recently sold in the seller's neighborhood, factor in the home's condition and any updates, then account for our holding and renovation costs plus a fair margin. Typical offer is 70-90% of after-repair value depending on condition and renovation scope.

## What sellers don't pay

No commissions. No listing fees. No closing costs charged to the seller. No repair costs. No cleaning costs (sellers can leave anything they don't want).

## Closing timelines

Typical 7-14 days from accepted offer. We can rush 5-day closings for foreclosure cases. Up to 60 days for sellers who need more time to find their next place.
